command:
set -eu
for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do [ "$(systemctl is-active sshd)" = active ] && break; sleep 1; done
[ "$(systemctl is-active sshd)" = active ]
node2_ip=$(printf '%s\n' "$CLUSTER_HOSTS" | awk '$2=="node2" {print $1; exit}')
[ -n "$node2_ip" ]
ssh_opts='-F /dev/null -o BatchMode=yes -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o IdentityFile=/home/opsbot/.ssh/id_ed25519 -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o ConnectTimeout=10'
printf '%s\n' '=== node1 key login ==='
runuser -u opsbot -- ssh $ssh_opts opsbot@"$NODE_IP" 'id -un; hostname; printf "key-login-ok-node1\n"'
printf '%s\n' '=== node2 key login ==='
runuser -u opsbot -- ssh $ssh_opts opsbot@"$node2_ip" 'id -un; hostname; printf "key-login-ok-node2\n"'
printf '%s\n' '=== password methods rejected ==='
for target in "$NODE_IP" "$node2_ip"; do
  set +e
  out=$(runuser -u opsbot -- ssh -F /dev/null -o BatchMode=yes -o PubkeyAuthentication=no -o PreferredAuthentications=password,keyboard-interactive -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o ConnectTimeout=10 opsbot@"$target" true 2>&1)
  rc=$?
  set -e
  printf 'target=%s rc=%s result=%s\n' "$target" "$rc" "$out"
  [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]
done
